description:
List available interface locales

Returns the user interface locales the platform ships, for populating a language picker or for validating a value before writing it to a profile or an agent. The list is read from the locale directories on disk, so it reflects the running build rather than a database table; reseller-specific locale folders are excluded. If that directory cannot be read the handler falls back to `en` and `de` instead of failing. Note two things about the shape: the response is a bare JSON array, not the usual `{ data: [...] }` envelope, and each entry carries only a `code`, with no display name. The route requires a valid API key but checks no scope.
name: list_languages
title: List available interface locales
